AboutPage.courseDescription: RS School is a free, community-driven educational initiative by the Rolling Scopes community. This project is built as part of the React course — a hands-on program where students learn modern frontend development by building real applications in teams.
AboutPage.projectDescription: Swagger Editor App is a localized web application for editing OpenAPI specifications, previewing API documentation, executing REST requests, and saving request history for authenticated users.
AboutPage.teamDescription: A three-person team building this project for the RS School React course.
AboutPage.techDescription: The application uses a modern React stack with static generation for public pages and Supabase for authentication and request history.
